name: gms-remote-test
description: Operate the GMS Remote Test platform through the bundled gms-rt CLI: device inventory, CTS/GTS/VTS/STS execution, durable job status, reports, firmware burn, USB/IP, VPN. Self-contained; requires GMS_REMOTE_TEST_SERVER. Authenticates via GMS_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE (Agent Service Token, 0600 file) so no platform password ever flows through the model; adds read-only device shell (gms_rt_shell), typed logcat capture (gms_rt_logcat), one-shot approved device shell (gms_rt_shell_exec with server-side approval tokens), admin step-up elevation (gms_rt_auth_elevate) and typed firmware burn (gms_rt_burn_firmware, approval-token gated); jobs output is rendered one line per job.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the GMS Remote Test Controller: devices, tests, jobs, reports, firmware

requiresEnv.name: GMS_REMOTE_TEST_SERVER
requiresEnv.description: Base URL of the GMS Remote Test Controller, e.g. https://CONTROLLER:5001

requiresEnv.name: GMS_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE
requiresEnv.description: Path to a 0600 Agent Service Token file (enroll once with gms-rt-agent-enroll); replaces password login for agents

requiresEnv.name: GMS_CURL_CA_CERT
requiresEnv.description: Path to a trusted CA bundle for the Controller's TLS certificate; set GMS_CURL_INSECURE=1 only for controlled self-signed deployments
